concepts.angle: Consistency beats quality until quality is the only thing left.
concepts.hook: post before it is ready or you will never post
concepts.coverImageIntent: young creator with laptop plain background

slides.text: your tenth post will beat your first no matter how long you polish the first.
ship weekly. review monthly. rebuild quarterly.
the algorithm cannot rank a draft.
nobody remembers the bad ones. they remember that you kept going.

concepts.angle: Most creators confuse output with a body of work.
concepts.hook: a hundred posts is not a portfolio
concepts.kicker: volume is not a body of work

slides.text: a portfolio has a point of view. a feed has a posting schedule.
pick three things you want to be known for. delete the rest.
repetition is how a style becomes recognisable, not how it becomes boring.
one idea, said well, a hundred ways.
slides.imageIntent: man with headphones white background studio

concepts.cta: save this before you post again
